title: Empty Inbox
description: A brand-new crew member's notification center should start out quiet — no phantom messages waiting for them before they've done anything.
successCondition: Register a new account and immediately call GET /api/notifications with its token, before triggering any notify-worthy action. The response is 200 with notifications equal to an empty array [] and unreadCount equal to 0.
hints: Use a genuinely fresh account for this — an account that's already booked a shipment or logged in multiple times may have notifications queued from those earlier actions.
This check should happen fast enough that even the delayed notification queue (default 500ms) hasn't had anything to deliver, since nothing was triggered in the first place.
